register.labelZh: SEE AND SEEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: SEE AND SEEP Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: see about 可以用來談論作出安排;see to 則可以表示處理工作或照料某人。；你可以用 see somebody in、see somebody out 和 see somebody off 描述陪伴或送別,也可以用see the New Year in 表示迎接新年。；see something through 表示堅持完成工作;see something off 則表示成功擊退威脅或挑戰。；see over 和 see round 適合用來描述查看住宅、學校或辦公室;seep away 則表示水慢慢滲走。
register.summaryEn: See about helps you talk about making arrangements, while see to helps you talk about dealing with a job or caring for somebody. You can see somebody in, see somebody out or see somebody off. You can also see the New Year in. See something through shows that you continue until a task is finished. See something off shows that you successfully defeat a threat or challenge. See over and see round are useful when viewing a home, school or office. Seep away describes water slowly escaping.
